findings.problem: D7: worktree_kit_check runs rev-parse and check-ignore in the tree named by -C without -c core.fsmonitor=false, before the foreign-repo ask
findings.scenario: same-user repo /tmp/r with core.fsmonitor=/tmp/r/x.sh; Bash call git -C /tmp/r worktree add .claude/worktrees/x -b y runs x.sh inside PreToolUse before any ask (proven live with a marker script)
findings.closure: a test-hooks case with a foreign -C repo whose core.fsmonitor writes a marker: no marker after the hook, verdict is the foreign-repo ask

findings.problem: D2: _search_parents calls os.listdir unguarded on depth-1/2 folders (and lists depth-2 folders for an unused depth-3 level)
findings.scenario: detect-server-roots on a project with an unreadable data/postgres volume (or on /) exits 1 with PermissionError instead of a JSON array
findings.closure: an SR case with an unreadable folder at depth 1 prints a JSON array and skips it; no listdir on depth-2 folders

findings.problem: D13: check-ignore -v also reports negated (!) re-include matches with rc 0; the code keeps them as ignored
findings.scenario: .gitignore settings.json then !.claude/settings.json gives DIVERGENCE .claude/settings.json and doctor exits 1; OK at base
findings.closure: a DW case with that gitignore gives ignored-loop-paths ok

findings.problem: D13: the drop keys on whole-.claude pattern text, not on the source:line worktree-kit names; a line can be reported twice or zero times
findings.scenario: .gitignore .claude/* then .claude/hooks/, no tracked kit: line 2 reported by worktree-kit and ignored-loop-paths, line 1 (.claude/*) reported nowhere (new); a lone .claude/hooks/ line reported twice (pre-existing)
findings.closure: a DW case with .claude/* + .claude/hooks/: ignored-loop-paths lists .claude/rules, .claude/hooks/ appears under worktree-kit only

findings.problem: D3: with prefixed roots wire no longer adds bare app/alembic to protected_dirs, the only thing that made rm -rf backend/app a deny (PROTECTED_TARGET matches the last segment after /); Gate Q4 rested on research's wrong fact that a bare app protects nothing
findings.scenario: IN73 state then rm -rf backend/app gets the generic recursive-rm ask instead of the protected-dir deny
findings.closure: a test-hooks case: server_roots [backend/app], protected_dirs after wire fastapi, rm -rf backend/app gives deny Cannot delete protected directory

findings.problem: D1: the message clause and the single-parent clause have no case that fails when they are deleted (G22.124/125 are refused by their paths)
findings.scenario: delete the msg/sha7 test or the parent-count test in assets_range_ok: every G22 case stays green while a wip-message add-only commit is pushed without a prompt
findings.closure: G22 cases: a well-formed add under feat/s1/ with a wrong message asks, and a two-parent commit in the range asks; each fails with its clause removed

findings.problem: compound command: the leftmost -C segment is judged, a bare kit-less segment after it now asks instead of deny
findings.scenario: git -C /tmp worktree add .claude/worktrees/a -b x; git worktree add .claude/worktrees/b -b y asks (deny at base)
findings.closure: every matching segment is judged

findings.problem: D1 path check ignores file mode and the sha7 folder: symlinks, gitlinks, any file under <branch>/ pass with a forged message
findings.scenario: a hand-made commit copying the message and adding feat/s1/notes.txt is pushed without prompt
findings.closure: only 100644 .png under <branch>/<msg sha7>/ pass

findings.problem: D1 rev-list/show/diff-tree follow refs/replace while push ignores them
findings.scenario: a replace ref shows the hook an add-only commit while the pushed objects differ (contortion, known limit)
findings.closure: the range checks run with --no-replace-objects

findings.problem: D7: quoted, tilde or variable -C paths are not matched or resolved
findings.scenario: git -C "/p with space" worktree add .claude/worktrees/x is not denied
findings.closure: a quoted -C case is denied

findings.problem: D1 git show --format=%B without --no-show-signature
findings.scenario: log.showSignature=true with signed assets commits: a legitimate publish now asks
findings.closure: the message read passes --no-show-signature

findings.problem: D1 diff-tree exit status unchecked inside the process substitution
findings.scenario: a failing diff-tree prints nothing and the commit passes the path check
findings.closure: a failed diff-tree refuses the range

findings.problem: D5 emits one MISSING with N evidence lines; server-roots can print ok and MISSING under one label
findings.scenario: two absent roots give one finding, plan step 7 asked one per root
findings.closure: one row per absent root, no ok row beside a MISSING

findings.problem: ignored-loop-paths summary says its one remedy, worktree-kit lists two
findings.scenario: the user reads one remedy where two are offered
findings.closure: the summary wording matches worktree-kit

findings.problem: the whole-.claude form set is kept twice (kit-doctor.py, install.sh:957); neither covers .claude/**/
findings.scenario: one copy is widened, the other not
findings.closure: a contracts case pins both sets equal

findings.problem: kit_ignored_untracked copies check_worktree_kit's predicate; plan step 8 says one place (verifier found no state where they disagree)
findings.scenario: an edit to one copy desynchronises the exactly-once guarantee
findings.closure: check_worktree_kit calls kit_ignored_untracked

findings.problem: D8 refusal names kit-track.py fork small-<name>, but small.md never says who writes and commits docs/specs/small/<name>.md in the forked tree
findings.scenario: on a kit-local project the lane cannot finish: the fork has no entry, rerunning /loop:small refuses again
findings.closure: small.md names the post-fork steps and the hand-over line

findings.problem: pre-existing: no documented recovery of local pr-assets after a declined cleanup push (refuted as a regression of D1)
findings.scenario: a declined drop stays local; every later publish stacks on it and asks, a blocked stop in auto
findings.closure: github.md Clean up says a declined Ask restores local pr-assets to origin

findings.problem: KD30 asserts only the evidence string absent, not no MISSING server-roots
findings.scenario: a MISSING with other wording passes
findings.closure: KD30 asserts no MISSING server-roots row

findings.problem: DW7 greps the summary anywhere, never asserts no probe listed nor no tracked claim
findings.scenario: a summary on another row passes
findings.closure: DW7 reads the ignored-loop-paths row

findings.problem: DG1/DG4 match only the blocked-stop prefix, shared with protect-files' guarded deny
findings.scenario: a guarded-path deny satisfies DG4 without the trap
findings.closure: DG1/DG4 match the config reason after the prefix

findings.problem: no case points -C at a tree other than the payload cwd
findings.scenario: a probe reading $BASE_DIR instead of the -C tree stays green
findings.closure: a -C case on another tree

findings.problem: SR10 expected order is also alphabetical, breadth-first order untested
findings.scenario: a depth-first walk passes
findings.closure: a/x/app with b/app expects b/app first

findings.problem: IW4-IW6 share one loop and all report as IW4
findings.scenario: IW5/IW6 ids never appear
findings.closure: each spelling reports its own id

findings.problem: floor 93 under 110 cases guards nothing
findings.scenario: dropping group_kitlocal stays green
findings.closure: floor equals the case count

findings.problem: nothing pins init.md step 14 command text to the exact allow string
findings.scenario: a reworded command brings the prompt back with every case green
findings.closure: a contracts case: init.md holds the exact allowed command

findings.problem: stale lp_assets_setup header and SR one-folder-down comment
findings.scenario: readers miss the four new variants
findings.closure: headers list the variants and depth 2

findings.problem: WT25 section || true swallows a missing step-5 anchor
findings.scenario: WT25 passes on text from later steps
findings.closure: a missing anchor fails WT25
